The organ that pumps blood is the heart.

Regarding the operational processes described in the text, the primary bottleneck is the lack of integration between software systems. This fragmentation causes repeated data entry and significant delays as representatives manually switch between platforms. A secondary inefficiency is the absence of a centralized knowledge base, which leads to inconsistent information being provided to customers. To improve efficiency, HomeTech should integrate its software systems to automate data flow and implement a centralized knowledge base to ensure consistent and accurate customer support.
